Daily tasks include performing routine checks, troubleshooting technical issues, conducting preventive maintenance, and replacing or upgrading parts to ensure optimal performance and reliability. The engineer will document repair activities, maintain accurate service records, and collaborate with the team to meet quality, safety, and efficiency standards. The role may also involve assisting with inventory management of spare parts, advising customers or internal stakeholders on best practices, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives in maintenance processes. Hands-on experience with Apple Mac devices, including hardware upgrades, system restoration, and performance optimization. Ability to read technical manuals, service guides, and schematics, and apply them in practical repair scenarios. Strong attention to detail, time management, and documentation skills, with a focus on quality and safety standards. Relevant technical diploma, degree, or certifications in electronics, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred. Previous experience in laptop service centers, repair shops, or IT support roles is an advantage.

review_candidates.title: Jr Centralized Control Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Purpose The Jr Centralized Control Engineer is responsible for executing and supervising the maintenance and performance of Centralized Control systems such as ATS, SCADA, and related automation platforms. This role supports the continuous, safe, and reliable operation of critical rail systems by implementing preventive and corrective maintenance tasks, managing technical documentation, and coordinating system troubleshooting efforts. The role also contributes to asset reliability by ensuring accurate data recording through Maximo and supporting compliance with RDMC's operational and safety standards. Responsibilities/Duties Profil de candidat recherché : System Maintenance & Performance Conduct preventive and corrective maintenance for Centralized Control systems including SCADA, ATS, and related automation equipment. Monitor and analyze system components and performance trends, identifying potential risks or degradation. Investigate and troubleshoot equipment failures or abnormalities and implement corrective measures. Recommend and support system upgrades or optimizations based on condition assessments and performance data. Prepare and update technical documentation related to system configuration, troubleshooting logs, and repair records. Team Coordination & Task Execution Coordinate and supervise daily tasks of technicians and maintainers, ensuring the timely execution of assigned work orders. Prioritize maintenance tasks based on system criticality and operational requirements. Facilitate communication and collaboration within the team; relay relevant information from management. Promote a culture of accountability, performance, and continuous learning among team members. Maximo Ensure timely and accurate entry of Maximo maintenance activities, work orders, and fault logs. Review data integrity within the CMMS system to support asset performance analysis and reporting. Generate standard maintenance and fault trend reports as management requests. Safety Enforce adherence to safety policies and procedures in all field maintenance activities. Oversee the correct application of work permits, lockout-tagout procedures, and access control protocols. Participate in incident investigations and safety audits as required. Ensure proper use of PPE and safe handling of tools and materials by the team. Operational Support & Reporting Assist in planning and scheduling maintenance interventions in coordination with operations and control room personnel. Conduct field inspections and compile status updates on system health and maintenance progress. Maintain and manage technical stock levels and recommend procurement for critical spares. Complete any additional duties assigned by the Head of Centralized Control. Qualifications ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS, KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Communication Engineering. Fluent in Arabic and English, French is a plus. Knowledge Strong understanding of low current systems, SCADA, and automation. Technical familiarity with electrical and electronic systems used in railway control environments. Basic proficiency in troubleshooting methodologies and diagnostic tools. Knowledge of safety and quality standards in industrial environments. Understanding of CMMS (preferably Maximo) usage and system integration is an advantage. Experience 0–3 years of experience in centralized control, automation, ATS & SCADA maintenance. Prior exposure to railway systems or industrial maintenance is desirable. Desired Behaviors & Experiences Technical Aptitude: Demonstrates strong foundational knowledge of centralized systems and readiness to learn. Team Collaboration: Works effectively within a team environment and contributes to team success. Communication Skills: Articulates ideas clearly and confidently; capable of reporting technical issues in a concise manner. Problem-Solving: Applies critical thinking to resolve issues with minimal supervision. Attention to Detail: Maintains high standards in system checks, reports, and documentation. Adaptability: Able to perform under pressure in a dynamic, safety-critical, shift-based environment. Accountability: Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities and maintains a proactive approach to tasks. Safety Orientation: Demonstrates a strong commitment to workplace safety and operational discipline.

Regularly update and maintain the CMMS database, ensuring accuracy of assets, work orders, and maintenance records. Implement system upgrades and enhancements to improve functionality and user experience Asset Management Develop, maintain, and optimize asset hierarchies, structures, and configurations within the CMMS to meet organizational goals and industry standards. Oversee asset lifecycle management, including acquisition, maintenance, and decommissioning, to maximize operational efficiency and return on investment. Ensure the integrity and accuracy of asset data entry, validation, and standardization within the CMMS. Data Analysis & Reporting Analyze CMMS data to track key performance indicators (KPIs), maintenance trends, and identify areas for process improvement. Generate and present detailed reports on equipment performance, maintenance schedules, and costs to support decision-making. Assist in the preparation of maintenance budgets and cost analysis. User Support And Training Provide technical support to end-users, troubleshooting system issues to ensure smooth operation. Conduct training sessions for maintenance teams to enhance the effective use of the CMMS, improving productivity and reporting accuracy. Continuous Improvement Identify opportunities to streamline maintenance processes through automation and system optimization. Stay current with industry trends and advancements in CMMS technology and maintenance practices. Lead and contribute to initiatives aimed at improving asset reliability and minimizing downtime. Safety Responsibilities Promote a positive safety culture within the workplace and attend any safety-related meetings or briefings as required within the job role. Comply with the requirements of RDMC RQHSE Policy and Safety Management System. Be mindful that Safety, Security, and Environmental protection are everyone’s responsibility. All staff members are accountable for reporting and intervening in any Safety, Security, or Environmental violations. Qualifications ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS, KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Knowledge Familiarity with IBM Maximo (preferred) or other CMMS platforms like SAP or COSWIN 8i, including configuration, administration, and troubleshooting. Understanding of asset lifecycle management and the ability to configure and optimize asset data and hierarchies within CMMS systems. Proficiency in analyzing CMMS data and using tools like Microsoft Excel to generate reports, identify KPIs, and drive process improvements. Understanding of CMMS process automation and optimization techniques to improve efficiency and system performance. Basic knowledge of project management principles for managing tasks and prioritizing maintenance operations effectively. Ability to provide IT support, troubleshoot user issues, and manage system integrations in CMMS software. Knowledge of documentation management practices and adherence to industry regulations and internal standards. Experience 0 to 3 years of experience in technical (maintenance or engineering) roles, with exposure to CMMS software. Hands-on experience with CMMS platforms, particularly IBM Maximo, or other platforms such as SAP, COSWIN 8i, or similar. Strong understanding of maintenance management processes and asset lifecycle management. Desired Behaviors & Experiences Demonstrates a team-oriented approach, working effectively across departments and with stakeholders. Anticipates challenges and implements solutions before issues escalate. Thrives in dynamic environments, quickly adjusting to new technologies, processes, and priorities. Ensures internal customers (e.g., maintenance teams) are supported with timely and accurate CMMS solutions. Actively seeks professional growth opportunities and stays informed about advancements in CMMS technology and maintenance practices. Leverages data insights to guide recommendations and optimize maintenance workflows.

DB-El Sewedy Rail Operation Egypt (DBEE) is looking for an IT Application Project Lead to join its team in Cairo and take a key role in delivering IT applications and solutions across Egypt’s high-speed railway organization. You will ensure that projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with the required quality , while keeping stakeholders aligned and ensuring that systems are stable, documented, tested, and ready for successful adoption. As the organization grows, the experience and relationships you build through project delivery will provide an excellent foundation for developing your expertise in enterprise application management and long-term IT ownership . Your Responsibilities Plan and manage IT projects end-to-end , including scope definition, scheduling, risk identification, delivery planning, and stakeholder coordination. Work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into clear delivery plans , defined acceptance criteria, and traceable project outcomes. Support structured change and release management , ensuring system changes are properly planned, controlled, and introduced with minimal business disruption. Coordinate release and go-live activities , including deployment planning, cutover preparation, implementation coordination, and post-release follow-up. Support functional testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by coordinating test execution, tracking defects, and ensuring users are prepared for go-live. Maintain the integrity of development, test, and production environments, proactively identifying risks related to system configuration and data quality . Work closely with internal IT teams, business stakeholders, and external vendors to keep projects on track and address delays or quality concerns at an early stage. Maintain accurate and structured project documentation , including project plans, risk and issue logs, decision records, action trackers, and status reports throughout the delivery lifecycle. What You Bring Educational background in IT, Computer Science, or a related field is welcome; demonstrated ability to successfully manage and deliver IT projects is equally important. 3–5 years of experience in IT project delivery, project coordination, or change and release management. Ability to independently manage project plans, risks, actions, and stakeholder communications . Familiarity with ITIL change management principles and structured release processes. Experience working with enterprise applications and coordinating deliveries involving multiple vendors and internal teams. Strong organizational and documentation skills, with a structured and methodical approach to project delivery . Excellent communication skills and the ability to keep diverse stakeholders aligned throughout the project lifecycle . PMP, PRINCE2, or ITIL 4 Foundation certifications are an advantage. Arabic is required , with strong professional English communication skills. Comfortable working on-site and during occasional off-hours cutovers when required. Why Join DBEE? Be part of Egypt’s first high-speed rail project . Gain hands-on experience in a high-profile, large-scale infrastructure environment . Work across IT, business, applications, vendors, and project teams , giving you broad exposure to enterprise technology delivery. Take real ownership of projects from planning through go-live . Develop your expertise in enterprise applications, ITIL processes, change management, and project delivery . Build experience within an organization combining international railway expertise with local excellence . Create a strong foundation for future opportunities in IT Project Management and Application Management . Ready to Make an Impact? If you are an organized and proactive IT professional who enjoys turning requirements into successful technology deliveries, this could be your opportunity to contribute to a project that will shape the future of mobility in Egypt. Join DBEE and help bring the future of high-speed rail to life. DB-El Sewedy Rail Operation Egypt is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates. We value diversity, inclusion, and a respectful, collaborative, and high-performing work environment.

review_candidates.title: Signaling Commissioning Engineer @Siemens Mobility Egypt
review_candidates.description: Siemens Mobility (SMO) is the world’s leading provider of mobility solutions that enable the efficient, safe, and environmentally friendly transport of people and goods—helping to improve the quality of everyday life for millions worldwide. Motivated by innovation, we develop intelligent solutions for the growing digitalization of the transport sector. Our offerings include rail vehicles, rail automation, road traffic management systems, rail electrification, and services. In Egypt, Siemens Mobility is implementing the European safety standards “ European Train Control System (ETCS) Level 1” . Spanning 950 km, this project is part of the broader Egypt National Railways Projects and aims to enhance the safety standards, increase the number of passenger trains, and boost freight capacity. Today, we are recruiting for a Signaling Commissioning Engineer to join our team in Egypt. This is an excellent career opportunity for professionals looking to join a truly international team in one of the biggest projects of Siemens Mobility. What are my responsibilities? Perform commissioning activities for railway systems, components, software, and technical solutions at installation sites. Analyze system performance, execute testing activities, and document commissioning results and reports. Plan and coordinate commissioning activities while ensuring timely execution and compliance with project requirements. Support system optimization through parameter settings and technical adjustments when required. Conduct customer handover activities and provide technical briefings and training to customer personnel. Ensure compliance with Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) standards while maintaining a safe working environment on site. Report site issues that may lead to claims or change orders and contribute to continuous process improvement initiatives. Collaborate with project teams and, where required, provide functional guidance to commissioning personnel on site. What do I need to qualify for this job? Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Automation & Control Engineering, or a related field. Up to 1 year of engineering experience in testing, commissioning, or field activities within the railway industry (recent graduates are encouraged to apply). Strong interest in rail technologies and sustainable mobility solutions. Willingness to learn Siemens-specific software and hardware platforms. Strong teamwork, communication, and problem-solving skills with a flexible and reliable working style. Comfortable using digital tools including laptops, tablets, and engineering applications. Fluency in both English and Arabic is mandatory. What else do I need to know? As a world leader in developing and producing the most advanced technologies, we improve lives and further human achievements worldwide, while also protecting the climate - all thanks to our employees. Working with us, you have the foundation to develop personally and professionally. We give you the chance to do something significant, that benefits society and human progress. We give you the chance to create a difference. At Siemens we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse Digital Minds to develop tomorrow ‘s reality. Find out more about the Digital world of Siemens here: www.siemens.com/careers/digitalminds Diversity at Siemens is our source of creativity and innovation. Having different types of talent and experiences makes us more ambitious and better prepared to respond successfully to the demands of the Society. Therefore, we value the candidates that reflect the Diversity that we enjoy in our Company. Please find more information at www.siemens.com We are looking forward to receiving your online application. Please note: Only complete applications can be considered in the selection process.

review_candidates.title: Service Desk Agent
review_candidates.description: We are looking for a dedicated and detail-oriented Service Desk Agent to join the Digital Egypt Team . This role is essential in ensuring efficient handling of support tickets, complaint resolution, and cross-team coordination. Key Responsibilities: Receive and process assigned service requests and support tickets through the designated ticketing system. Review ticket information and verify that all required data and supporting documents are complete and accurate. Categorize, prioritize, and route tickets to the appropriate support team or Service Manager. Handle tickets within the agreed SLA and operational turnaround time. Monitor pending and returned tickets and take the required follow-up actions. Update ticket status, actions taken, notes, and resolution details accurately in the system. Identify incorrectly submitted, incomplete, duplicated, or misrouted tickets and take the appropriate corrective action. Escalate delayed, critical, repeated, or unresolved cases according to the approved escalation matrix. Coordinate with Service Managers, the Follow-Up function, and Quality Assurance to ensure proper ticket handling. Correct identified errors within the required timeframe, normally by the next working day. Follow approved Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), service guidelines, and information-security requirements. Maintain the confidentiality of customer, government, and service-related information. Participate in team meetings, coaching sessions, assessments, and operational training. Support workload distribution during peak periods. Prepare or contribute to daily productivity and ticket-status reports when required. Perform any other service-desk-related duties assigned by the direct manager. Requirements: Experience in service desk or technical support roles. Strong problem-solving and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines. Familiarity with ticketing systems and government service platforms is a plus. If you're interested, please send your cv to the following email: hr@eserve.com.eg
